title: Nirvana Soul Coffee
venue_description:
Overview

Nirvana Soul Coffee is a vibrant community-centered coffee shop in downtown San Jose founded by sisters Jeronica Macey and Be'Anka Ashaolu with a mission to bring people together through high-quality coffee tea and joyful experiences. Opened in September 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic Nirvana Soul became one of San Jose's first Black women-owned cafés and has since grown into a beloved South Bay coffee company with multiple locations including downtown San Jose Cupertino San Francisco and a location at the Dr. MLK Jr. Library at SJSU.

Music and Events

The downtown location at 315 S 1st Street hosts Nirvana Soul After Dark - weekly open mic nights every Friday from 6-9 PM. These events welcome musicians poets and comedians of all experience levels creating a supportive environment for performers to share their talents. The venue also features rotating galleries of local artwork small business pop-ups and various community events reinforcing its role as a cultural hub in downtown San Jose.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The cafe offers a colorful joyful environment with ample indoor seating and a cozy second-floor loft area perfect for working meetings or hanging out with friends. The space features excellent wifi making it ideal for remote work or studying and there's even a piano available for use with permission. The venue is within walking distance of San Jose Convention Center SJSU SoFA Market César Chávez Park and the Center for Performing Arts.

Coffee and Food

Nirvana Soul serves specialty-grade single-origin coffee and blends freshly roasted at their North San Jose roasting facility. The menu includes thoughtfully crafted specialty lattes like the Golden Child and Ube latte fresh-made waffles including chorizo con queso bacon cheddar churro and chocolate chip varieties and gourmet pastries from The French Spot. They offer plant-based milk options and vegan treats making the menu accessible to all dietary preferences.

Community Impact

Since opening Nirvana Soul has established itself as an accessible and inclusive gathering place that celebrates local artists supports small businesses and brings people together over excellent coffee and tea. Whether you're looking to perform at open mic meet friends get work done or simply enjoy a great cup of coffee in a welcoming atmosphere Nirvana Soul Coffee delivers joyful experiences rooted in community connection and quality.

title: Bogey's Pizza Co.
venue_description:
Overview

Bogey's Pizza Co. has been a beloved family-friendly restaurant in San Jose for over 25 years delighting customers with their signature pizza featuring a special spice blend found nowhere else. Located on Almaden Expressway this bright open-concept restaurant serves much more than just pizza - it's become a treasured community gathering place for celebrations casual dinners and weekly live music.

South Bay Folks Acoustic Open Mic

Every Friday evening from 6-9 PM Bogey's hosts the South Bay Folks Acoustic Open Mic one of the most welcoming and entertaining open mics in the Bay Area. Sign-ups begin at 5:45 PM and the event features a wonderful mix of musicians from complete beginners to seasoned professionals. Each performer gets two songs or 10 minutes whichever comes first. The event provides a PA system with two mics and two line inputs - keyboards are welcome while electric guitars are discouraged to maintain the acoustic vibe. Backup musicians are always available making this an especially supportive environment for newer performers.

Music Policy

The open mic maintains an acoustic-only policy with an exception for electric bass when plugged directly into the board. All genres are welcomed creating a diverse musical experience. While many performers fall into the folk category the evening showcases a wide variety of musical styles. Instruments with pickups must plug into the board and performers should arrive tuned up and ready as setup time is subtracted from performance time.

Dining and Atmosphere

Bogey's offers a full bar great pizza with generous toppings a salad bar and family-friendly dining in a sports-friendly atmosphere. The venue is perfect for hosting events including birthdays baby showers sports team celebrations retirement parties and even weddings - they can make gatherings as fancy or casual as desired. The restaurant features Monday and Tuesday specials and maintains a welcoming environment where families and music lovers alike feel at home.

Community Connection

What makes Bogey's special is the combination of great food reasonable prices and a genuine commitment to supporting local musicians and the arts. The friendly atmosphere Covid-safety measures and community spirit create an environment where you won't find a more welcoming open mic anywhere in the region. Whether you're coming to perform enjoy live music or just grab great pizza with family Bogey's Pizza Co. delivers on all fronts.

title: Poor House Bistro
venue_description:
Overview

Poor House Bistro brings the authentic sights sounds and tastes of New Orleans to San Jose operating out of a historic Victorian home in the city's Little Italy district. Originally opened in 2005 in the Meduri family home the venue was purchased by Google and the entire structure was moved several blocks north in 2022 to its current location at 317 W St John Street. This New Orleans-style juke joint and eatery has become a staple in the local music scene and a beloved gathering spot near the SAP Center.

Live Music Program

Poor House Bistro features live music seven days a week making it one of the most consistent venues for blues and roots music in the South Bay. Wednesday evenings from 6-9 PM host a blues jam with rotating seasoned hosts - the jam has been on and off over the years but has recently returned strong with regulars taking turns leading the session. Thursdays feature the PHB Famiglia Band led by owner Jay Meduri and weekends showcase rotating blues acts. Sunday brunches from 10 AM-2 PM often feature jazz artists while afternoon sets can include blues rock reggae or country - and it's all free with no cover charge.

Venue and Atmosphere

The restaurant maintains its historic Victorian charm while creating that authentic New Orleans funky atmosphere. An outdoor patio with live music creates an intimate setting perfect for experiencing blues up close. The venue also hosts one of the stages at the annual San Jose Fountain Blues & Brews Festival cementing its role as a cornerstone of the local blues community. With its legendary po'boys warm hospitality and commitment to live music Poor House Bistro never disappoints whether you're there for the tunes the food or the friendly faces.

Food and Drink

The menu celebrates classic New Orleans and Creole Italian cuisine featuring blackened chicken wings BBQ shrimp platter seafood gumbo Cajun popcorn salad po'boys crawfish pasta red beans and rice corn muffins jambalaya and muffaletta. The restaurant offers a full bar Italian wine and craft beer selection. With over 20 years of fine Cajun-style cooking Poor House uses the freshest ingredients and you can taste the love that goes into every dish.

Location and Access

Poor House Bistro is conveniently located near Caltrain and SAP Center about a 5-minute walk from the arena. The venue offers free parking in the back lot and metered street parking is available nearby potentially free at night and on Sundays. Hours vary by day - the bistro is closed Mondays and Tuesdays except for Sharks games and some SAP events. Wednesday and Thursday hours are 11 AM-2 PM and 5-8 PM Friday and Saturday 11 AM-9 PM and Sunday 10 AM-7 PM with brunch from 10 AM-2 PM.
location: 317 W St John St San Jose CA 95110

title: Narrative Fermentations
venue_description:
Overview

Narrative Fermentations is a creative story-driven craft brewery located on Alma Avenue near downtown San Jose. The brewery specializes in producing a constantly rotating selection of innovative craft beers including crisp lagers West Coast IPAs experimental fruited sours pilsners stouts and dark beers. With a laid-back taproom charming outdoor patio and commitment to community Narrative has become a favorite gathering spot for beer enthusiasts and music lovers alike.

Blues Jam and Live Music

Every Sunday from 4-7 PM Narrative Fermentations hosts a blues jam featuring a house band comprised of some of the San Francisco Bay Area's finest blues musicians. The jam is often hosted by Aki Kumar San Jose's own King of Bollywood Blues known for his harmonica skills and unique fusion of Chicago/Delta-style blues with Bollywood influences. Musicians and singers are welcome to sign up and perform with full backline provided including drums bass guitar harmonica and vocal mics - performers just need to bring their instruments. The brewery also hosts other regular live music events and community gatherings throughout the week.

Taproom and Atmosphere

The venue features both indoor seating close to the bar and extensive outdoor seating with large picnic tables creating a relaxed community-focused environment. The spacious inviting brewery is ideal for both casual outings and large group gatherings. Rotating food trucks provide delicious food options that pair perfectly with the carefully crafted beers and ciders. The brewery maintains a laid-back atmosphere perfect for enjoying creative craft beverages while listening to live music or simply hanging out with friends.

Beer Selection

Narrative Fermentations offers visitors a constantly evolving selection of creatively imagined craft beers showcasing innovation and quality. From traditional styles to experimental brews the brewery's range ensures there's something for every palate. The focus on freshness local ingredients and creative brewing techniques has earned Narrative a strong reputation among South Bay beer aficionados.

Practical Information

Located at 101 E Alma Ave the brewery is open Monday-Friday 3-9 PM Saturday 11 AM-9 PM and Sunday 12-7 PM. Ample parking is available for guests. The venue features one unisex restroom which can have lines during busy times. For current event information rotating food truck schedules and beer releases follow Narrative Fermentations on Instagram at @narrative_fermentations. Contact: (408) 288-5181.
location: 101 E Alma Ave San Jose CA 95112

title: Woodhams Sports Lounge
venue_description:
Overview

Woodhams Sports Lounge is a vibrant dive bar and community hub located in Santa Clara that has become beloved for its welcoming inclusive atmosphere diverse entertainment and genuine sense of family. Run by owner and bartender Amanda the venue embraces its quirky character while providing quality drinks great music and a safe space where everyone from all backgrounds and walks of life feels at home. Whether you're LGBTQ+ a regular or a first-time visitor Woodhams makes everyone feel like they belong.

Live Music and Jams

Mondays feature Open Mic Jam Night from 8-11 PM hosted by Jimmy Tone and JSL Project. The current jam combines live music with live karaoke and leans toward rock styles. First Fridays host the legendary Rockin' n Blues Jam with Bob Gonzalez starting at 9 PM after sign-ups at 8:30 PM - this is one of the South Bay's longest-running blues sessions known for its raw authentic gritty atmosphere full of heart. Other Fridays rotate between band nights featuring groups like Honey Wilders Band and Vinyl Council Night.

Entertainment Schedule

The lounge truly offers something every night of the week. Tuesdays Thursdays and Saturdays feature karaoke with different KJs including Nico Darius and Rafael - Saturday's last session of each month is theme night so check their social media. Wednesdays are Flashback 80s Night with DJ Hex. Second and fourth Sundays host Goth/Industrial/Emo nights with DJ Hex and Iridescent. Free pool is available Sundays and Wednesdays and sports are shown on multiple TVs especially on Sundays.

Atmosphere and Amenities

The venue features a cozy single-level layout with wheelchair accessibility via ramp. The eclectic decor embraces an obvious and odd mish-mash that gives the space its unique personality and charm. While it can get busy on live band nights the space remains comfortable and the crowd flow is well-managed. The bar serves affordable drinks cocktails and bar food including hot links hot dogs and nachos. They accept Apple Pay credit cards except Amex and cash.

Community Values

Woodhams prides itself on being a no-frills establishment that focuses on what matters most: quality drinks great music and genuine community connection. The venue is explicitly inclusive and accepting of all regardless of gender sexual orientation or race. Hateful attitudes and speech are not tolerated - this is a designated safe space where kindness and respect are paramount. Many patrons describe the venue as a place where everybody really does know your name fostering exceptionally strong bonds and making visitors feel like regulars almost immediately. Location: 4475 Stevens Creek Blvd Santa Clara. Hours: Daily 2 PM-1:30 AM. Phone: (408) 244-2899.
location: 4475 Stevens Creek Blvd Santa Clara CA 95051

title: Fuego Sports Bar & Club
venue_description:
Overview

Fuego Sports Bar & Club in Sunnyvale has become the current home for one of the South Bay's most respected and longest-running blues jam sessions. The venue provides a lively sports bar atmosphere with full bar service multiple TVs for sports viewing and a welcoming environment that has embraced the blues community.

Monday Blues Jam

Every Monday evening from 8-11 PM Fuego hosts a professional-level blues jam that has been a fixture of the South Bay music scene for years. The session is led by Dennis Dove and his long-running crew with Johnny Cat and Mike Phillips serving as regular hosts. This is not a beginner jam - it attracts skilled accomplished musicians who bring their expertise and passion for authentic blues. The Dove crew's jam has moved locations over the years but has maintained its reputation for quality musicianship and welcoming spirit creating memorable musical moments week after week.

Jam Details

The jam provides full backline so musicians can bring their instruments and join the rotation. The session has built a loyal following of both performers and listeners who appreciate authentic blues played with skill heart and soul. The pro-level nature of the jam means players should come prepared to perform at a high standard though the atmosphere remains supportive for those who can hold their own.

Venue Experience

As a sports bar and club Fuego offers the amenities you'd expect including a full selection of drinks and a casual comfortable environment. The combination of sports viewing capabilities and commitment to live music makes it a versatile venue that serves both sports fans during games and music lovers on Monday nights. The location on Murphy Avenue in Sunnyvale provides convenient access for South Bay musicians and blues enthusiasts.

title: Little Lou's BBQ
venue_description:
Overview

Little Lou's BBQ in Campbell is a well-loved BBQ restaurant that has become an important venue for live blues music in the South Bay. Combining delicious authentic BBQ with a welcoming atmosphere for musicians Little Lou's offers the perfect pairing of great food and great music.

Thursday Blues Jam

Every Thursday evening from 6-9 PM Little Lou's hosts a blues jam that was well-established at another venue before relocating here. The session features rotating hosts and provides full backline for musicians making it easy for players to show up with their instruments and join in. The jam welcomes blues musicians ready to participate in the rotation and has built a community of regular players and listeners who appreciate the combination of quality BBQ and authentic blues.

Important Notes

Musicians and fans should be aware that blues jam sessions may occasionally be pre-empted by major sports broadcasts. It's recommended to check the venue's calendar before making the trip to ensure the jam is happening that particular Thursday. This flexibility helps the venue serve both its music community and sports fans.

Food and Atmosphere

Little Lou's serves delicious BBQ in a laid-back casual environment. The restaurant creates an authentic atmosphere where the love of good food and good music come together naturally. Whether you're coming to play listen or just enjoy some quality BBQ Little Lou's delivers on both the culinary and musical fronts making it a valued destination in Campbell.

Community Role

By providing a home for the blues jam session after it relocated from another venue Little Lou's has demonstrated its commitment to supporting the local music community. The Thursday night jam has become an important part of the South Bay blues scene giving musicians a regular place to gather play and connect while audiences enjoy great music alongside their meals.

title: First Unitarian Church of San Jose
venue_description:
Overview

First Unitarian Church of San Jose is a welcoming community church located in downtown San Jose that opens its doors to the broader community for various events including a unique monthly open mic and game night. The church's beautiful sanctuary features exceptional acoustics making it an ideal venue for musical and spoken word performances.

Open Mic and Game Night

Held on the second Saturday of each month from 6-9:30 PM this creative event combines two forms of entertainment in separate spaces. The sanctuary hosts open mic performances featuring music and spoken word in a beautiful acoustically-rich setting. Sign-ups begin at 6 PM with a performer drawing at 6:20 PM ensuring fair opportunities for all who want to perform. Meanwhile the social hall offers games including cards and board games - attendees are welcome to bring their own games to share with others.

Performance Environment

The sanctuary provides a stunning venue for performances with great acoustics that enhance both vocal and instrumental music. The beautiful setting creates an inspiring atmosphere for performers and a pleasant listening experience for audiences. The church's commitment to the arts and community expression makes it a supportive environment for artists of all levels whether sharing original compositions or performing beloved pieces.

Practical Information

The event is free to attend though donations are welcomed to support use of the church facilities. Limited drinks are available for purchase. The combination of open mic in the sanctuary and games in the social hall creates a welcoming community gathering where people can choose to perform listen socialize over games or enjoy both aspects of the evening. For more information contact Rick at (408) 930-7372. The church is located at 160 N 3rd St in downtown San Jose providing convenient access for performers and attendees from throughout the area.
